column7: SAML responses are checked namespace-aware before the library runs (one Assertion, one Subject/NameID, one Conditions; HTTP-POST binding with plaintext assertions only), the library result must carry the same NameID, and a library panic is a refused login; also covered by TestParseResponse_RefusesArtifactBinding, TestStrictAssertionShape_RefusesEncryptedAssertion and TestParseResponseRecovered_TurnsLibraryPanicIntoError
